claims.claim: TableDebouncer.drainRemainingOnStop sorts all pendingBatches in ascending sequence order (seq) and shares a single 4s drainCtx across all batches so excess tasks receive drainCtx.Err() and NATS NakWithDelay instead of violating the 15s shutdown budget.

In SnapshotRunnerHandler.runSnapshot (G1), when ctx.Done() fires at the top of the batch loop and r.stopping.Load() is true, it calls r.markProgressPaused(progressID) and returns nil instead of returning a cancellation error.

In Worker TransmuteJobRepo.UpdateStatus (G2), when status is RUNNING or PAUSED, the query filters by cancel_requested = false AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED') so worker shutdown never overwrites a user-cancelled job with PAUSED.

In BatchTransformHandler.runTransformJob (G3), GetByID restores parsedForce and parsedFields into isForceJob and forceFieldsNote before building forceSet and setClauses, and BatchBuffer.Stop() (G4) waits up to 4500ms on bb.doneCh before calling bb.cancel().
